roles.job_title: Software Development Engineer II — Seller Springboard

assignments.title: Deduplicate seller registrations
assignments.coding_prompt: Return registration records in first-seen order, keeping only the first record for each normalized email (trim, lowercase). Preserve all other fields.
assignments.design_prompt: Design the registration write path so retries cannot create duplicate seller accounts. Name the unique key and explain conflict behavior.

assignments.title: Seller registration form with errors
assignments.coding_prompt: Build a controlled registration form with name and email fields. On submit, show field errors next to controls, focus the first invalid field, and show a success status for valid input.
assignments.design_prompt: Sketch an accessible seller registration form, labels, error summary, focus placement, and server validation boundary.

assignments.title: Sliding window: verification budget
assignments.coding_prompt: Given nonnegative per-request costs and a budget, return the maximum length of a contiguous request window whose sum is at most budget. Check empty input, zero budget, and a single cost above budget.
assignments.design_prompt: A seller identity provider sends bursts. Describe admission control and what metrics protect user experience.

assignments.title: Responsive inventory filter
assignments.coding_prompt: Add controlled search and min/max quantity filters to the inventory list. Preserve order, show an empty state, and keep the filter usable at a narrow viewport.
assignments.design_prompt: Explain table filtering on narrow screens and keyboard-accessible filter controls.

assignments.title: Validate onboarding workflow steps
assignments.coding_prompt: Return true if brackets in a workflow expression are balanced and correctly nested; ignore non-bracket characters.
assignments.design_prompt: How would you version workflow definitions while keeping in-flight applications safe?

assignments.title: Async onboarding form state
assignments.coding_prompt: Submit the form through an injected Promise-based API. Show pending, success, retryable error, and validation states; prevent duplicate submits while pending.
assignments.design_prompt: Design disabled/loading/error states and announce state changes without trapping keyboard users.

assignments.title: Find eligibility threshold
assignments.coding_prompt: For sorted numeric thresholds, return the first index whose value is at least target, or the list length if none exists.
assignments.design_prompt: Explain how to make eligibility rules auditable when thresholds vary by country.

assignments.title: Price-band selector
assignments.coding_prompt: Build a keyboard-operable price-band selector. Keep selected value in state, update the description, and gracefully handle a value outside all bands.
assignments.design_prompt: Describe a searchable catalog API and client behavior for empty/loading/error responses.

assignments.title: Reverse a linked list of request nodes
assignments.coding_prompt: Reverse a singly linked list in place and return the new head. Do not copy node values into a replacement list; handle null and one-node lists.
assignments.design_prompt: Sketch an idempotent registration API response for first request, retry, and payload conflict.

assignments.title: Stable inventory row identity
assignments.coding_prompt: Render selectable inventory rows using stable IDs with SKU fallback. Selection must survive reorder and data refresh.
assignments.design_prompt: Propose reusable component props that remain stable across pagination and refresh.

assignments.title: Validate prerequisite tree
assignments.coding_prompt: Given a nested tree of steps, return step IDs in breadth-first order.
assignments.design_prompt: How would you detect and communicate a blocked prerequisite without losing the seller’s progress?

assignments.title: Fulfillment tree navigation
assignments.coding_prompt: Render nested fulfillment choices with keyboard-operable expand/collapse, visible focus, and disabled-node handling.
assignments.design_prompt: Make nested fulfillment navigation usable with keyboard and screen readers.

assignments.title: Prioritize manual reviews
assignments.coding_prompt: Return up to k seller IDs sorted by descending risk score, breaking ties by ascending ID.
assignments.design_prompt: Set a safe review queue policy that avoids starvation and supports a reason for priority.

assignments.title: Sortable inventory table
assignments.coding_prompt: Add sortable column headers with accessible ascending/descending state. Null values stay last and ID breaks ties.
assignments.design_prompt: Discuss sorting large lists: server vs client, virtualization, and accessibility announcement.

assignments.title: Merge compliance windows
assignments.coding_prompt: Merge overlapping or touching [start,end] intervals, returning sorted intervals.
assignments.design_prompt: How should the service resolve conflicting policy windows from two authoritative sources?

assignments.title: Placement timeline
assignments.coding_prompt: Render availability intervals on a responsive timeline, merge overlaps, label time spans, and provide a text alternative.
assignments.design_prompt: Design a timeline that communicates timezone, unavailable periods, and mobile layout.

assignments.title: Order registration prerequisites
assignments.coding_prompt: Return a valid topological order of a DAG; return null if a cycle exists. Use lexical order to break ties.
assignments.design_prompt: Design dependency execution for country-specific onboarding without hard-coding one sequence.

assignments.title: Dependency-driven wizard
assignments.coding_prompt: Show only steps whose prerequisites are complete. Prevent next-step navigation around missing dependencies and explain why a step is blocked.
assignments.design_prompt: How should a wizard recover if backend policy changes while the user is on a step?

assignments.title: Find valid rule combinations
assignments.coding_prompt: From candidate integer rule IDs, return all unique combinations summing to target; each candidate may be used once. Sort each combination and result lexically.
assignments.design_prompt: How would you explain a multi-rule rejection so that a seller can fix it?

assignments.title: Inventory facet controls
assignments.coding_prompt: Build checkbox facets with counts, selected-state chips, clear-all, and an empty-results message.
assignments.design_prompt: Design filter facets that remain understandable with many combinations and clear-all behavior.

assignments.title: Trie prefix lookup for document fields
assignments.coding_prompt: Build/use a trie to return the original field names that begin with a case-insensitive prefix, sorted lexicographically. Return all fields for an empty prefix.
assignments.design_prompt: Describe safe extraction boundaries for synthetic document text; what must never be inferred automatically?

assignments.title: Debounced autocomplete
assignments.coding_prompt: Implement an accessible combobox using an injected async search API, debounce typing, cancel stale requests, and support arrow/enter/escape.
assignments.design_prompt: Specify combobox keyboard behavior and safe rendering of matched text.

assignments.title: Minimum-cost onboarding path with DP
assignments.coding_prompt: Given a nonnegative cost for each ordered step, start before step 0 or step 1 and move forward by one or two steps. Return the minimum cost to reach beyond the final step. Implement a bottom-up DP and explain its state and complexity.
assignments.design_prompt: Discuss when an estimated risk score must not replace a deterministic compliance rule.

assignments.title: Async placement cost summary
assignments.coding_prompt: Fetch a fee quote through an injected async port and render integer-cent subtotal/fee/total. Show stale, loading, and error states.
assignments.design_prompt: Keep price explanation consistent when quotes refresh asynchronously.

assignments.title: Verification retry schedule
assignments.coding_prompt: For tasks with retry-after minute and priority, return IDs ordered by earliest retry time, then highest priority, then ID.
assignments.design_prompt: How do you bound retry storms and honor provider retry-after guidance?

assignments.title: Lazy placement list
assignments.coding_prompt: Load the next page with a visible control and loading status; preserve prior rows and announce completion or failure.
assignments.design_prompt: Balance eager loading and lazy loading on a slow mobile network.

assignments.title: Connected duplicate-account clusters
assignments.coding_prompt: Return connected component count for account IDs linked by duplicate pairs. IDs absent from pairs still count as components.
assignments.design_prompt: What evidence is needed before merging accounts, and how can a mistaken merge be reversed?

assignments.title: Marketplace group picker
assignments.coding_prompt: Render connected marketplace groups as selectable chips, include isolated marketplaces, and keep selection stable when groups reorder.
assignments.design_prompt: Represent a seller operating across marketplaces without conflating account identity.

assignments.title: Registration idempotency lookup
assignments.coding_prompt: Apply events to a key-value map: first value for each key wins; return values in input order for every event, with null for duplicate keys.
assignments.design_prompt: Define idempotency scope, retention, and payload-mismatch behavior for a registration endpoint.

assignments.title: URL-synced placement filters
assignments.coding_prompt: Read filter state from query parameters and write changes back without losing unrelated parameters. Normalize duplicate filters.
assignments.design_prompt: Explain query-cache ownership and when an optimistic update must be rolled back.

assignments.title: Policy version cache
assignments.coding_prompt: Simulate an LRU cache of positive capacity. Each op is ["get",key] or ["put",key,value]; return get results (null on miss).
assignments.design_prompt: How will policy version changes invalidate cached eligibility without serving stale decisions?

assignments.title: Policy version cache guard
assignments.coding_prompt: Use TanStack Query for policy-versioned data. Invalidate on version change and prevent stale cached data from appearing as current.
assignments.design_prompt: Plan cache invalidation and private response clearing on user/account change.

assignments.title: Detect overlapping application writes
assignments.coding_prompt: Given versioned updates [applicationId, expectedVersion], return true if two updates target the same application version.
assignments.design_prompt: Explain optimistic concurrency and the user-visible recovery when two devices save simultaneously.

assignments.title: Stale-response guard
assignments.coding_prompt: Fetch placement results as filters change. Abort obsolete requests and only commit the response with the highest request sequence, even if an older request resolves later; test this delayed-response race.
assignments.design_prompt: Describe cancellation, late-response guards, and skeleton/error behavior during navigation.

assignments.title: Compute bounded retry delays
assignments.coding_prompt: Return capped exponential delays for attempts 0..n-1, starting at base and capped at max; no random jitter.
assignments.design_prompt: Design an external identity-provider adapter that retries safely after timeout.

assignments.title: Resilient quote status
assignments.coding_prompt: Fetch quotes and render loading, ready, retryable, and permanent-error views with a retry control and preserved prior data.
assignments.design_prompt: Design a quote API view resilient to timeout, partial data, and repeated refresh.

assignments.title: Latest registration status with SQL and an index
assignments.coding_prompt: In `sde/sql/day19.sql`, write SQL that counts sellers by their latest event state (order by created_at descending, then event_id descending). Return state/count rows sorted by state. Create and justify a covering-friendly index for the latest-per-seller access pattern.
assignments.design_prompt: Propose a relational schema and index for latest state plus an immutable audit trail.

assignments.title: Typed payload boundary
assignments.coding_prompt: Decode an unknown placement payload before rendering. Reject malformed rows, supply documented defaults, and show a safe data-error state.
assignments.design_prompt: Define typed UI/API models and prevent display-only fields from becoming authority.

assignments.title: Allowlist analytics properties
assignments.coding_prompt: Keep only allowlisted keys from an event; reject the entire event if any key contains a forbidden case-insensitive substring from [email,phone,token,health]. Return null on rejection.
assignments.design_prompt: Threat-model seller onboarding telemetry. Separate business audit from best-effort analytics.

assignments.title: Safe seller text rendering
assignments.coding_prompt: Render untrusted seller-provided text as text, never HTML. Include a fixture with markup-looking content and verify it remains inert.
assignments.design_prompt: Review XSS/CSRF and safe URL handling in a seller-facing UI.

assignments.title: Regional policy coverage map
assignments.coding_prompt: Given country requirements and globally supported fields, return each country’s sorted required fields that are unsupported. Omit countries with no gaps. This is a deterministic planning helper; the separate design block is the architecture exercise.
assignments.design_prompt: Draw the high-level architecture; state your consistency choices and how a seller resumes safely.

assignments.title: FBA placement compare flow
assignments.coding_prompt: Build a placement comparison view that shows options, freshness, fees, selection, and recovery for partial or stale quotes.
assignments.design_prompt: Draw components and data flow; cover server state, URL filters, and error recovery.

assignments.title: Evaluate deterministic compliance rules
assignments.coding_prompt: For each rule in order, return a decision record with rule id and PASS/FAIL based on whether its required field is present and non-empty in the supplied application. Never infer missing evidence.
assignments.design_prompt: Show interfaces for rule, context, decision, and explanation. Include deterministic ordering.

assignments.title: Accessible field component
assignments.coding_prompt: Create a reusable field component with label, hint, error, required state, and correct `aria-describedby`; verify with role-based tests.
assignments.design_prompt: Describe component boundaries, focus/validation, and how consumers customize safely.

assignments.title: Outbox event ordering
assignments.coding_prompt: Given events with aggregate ID and sequence, return true if each aggregate’s sequence is strictly increasing in given order.
assignments.design_prompt: Explain transactional outbox, consumer deduplication, and reconciliation when a notification is delayed.

assignments.title: Bounded quote polling
assignments.coding_prompt: Poll quotes with capped exponential delays and a maximum attempt count. Stop after success, cancellation, or max attempts.
assignments.design_prompt: Choose polling vs push for quote updates and explain freshness/battery tradeoff.

assignments.title: Summarize service health
assignments.coding_prompt: Compute availability percentage from successful and total requests as a number rounded to two decimals; zero total returns 100.
assignments.design_prompt: Define one user-centric SLO, alert threshold, and an on-call runbook first action.
assignments.leadership_principle: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility

assignments.title: Web-vitals panel
assignments.coding_prompt: Render LCP samples into accessible good/needs-improvement/poor states; never send raw URLs or user identifiers.
assignments.design_prompt: Pick a frontend SLO and privacy-safe telemetry fields for it.
assignments.leadership_principle: Success and Scale Bring Broad Responsibility

assignments.title: Validate assisted extraction
assignments.coding_prompt: Given proposed fields and allowed field names, return only allowed keys whose values are strings; return a separate list of rejected keys sorted.
assignments.design_prompt: Design human review, provenance, and deterministic compliance checks around an LLM suggestion.

assignments.title: Recommendation explanation panel
assignments.coding_prompt: Render only allowlisted explanation codes as plain text; cap content and show source/freshness metadata.
assignments.design_prompt: Design explanation UI for generated recommendations with source, freshness, and human override.

assignments.title: Classify registration outcomes
assignments.coding_prompt: For each response code: 200/201 -> success, 409 -> conflict, 429/500/503 -> retryable, all others -> permanent; preserve input order.
assignments.design_prompt: Write a failure-injection test plan for timeout-after-commit and duplicate delivery.

assignments.title: Quote contract tests
assignments.coding_prompt: Add contract cases for valid, empty, malformed, stale, and partial quote responses. Render safe states for each.
assignments.design_prompt: Create component/API contract cases for empty, malformed, stale, and partial quote payloads.

assignments.title: Top-k review optimization
assignments.coding_prompt: Implement top-k using any approach; explain complexity and avoid sorting all records when k is small.
assignments.design_prompt: Revisit an earlier Striver pattern: compare heap and full sort with bounds and edge cases.

assignments.title: Responsive image gallery
assignments.coding_prompt: Render placement images with responsive sizing and meaningful alt text; identify and handle missing or invalid descriptors.
assignments.design_prompt: Audit a responsive list for keyboard flow, contrast, image alternatives, and rendering cost.

assignments.title: Minimum window target sum
assignments.coding_prompt: Return shortest contiguous subarray length whose sum is at least target; return 0 if none. Values are positive.
assignments.design_prompt: After coding, state invariants and test a slightly modified case; do not reproduce an anecdote verbatim.

assignments.title: Keyboard tab bar
assignments.coding_prompt: Implement roving tabindex, arrow-key movement, Home/End, and panel selection for a three-tab placement view.
assignments.design_prompt: Use a timed exercise, then explain keyboard semantics, history behavior, and a novel edge case.

assignments.title: Timed mock: per-seller token bucket
assignments.coding_prompt: Implement per-seller token buckets. A new seller starts with capacity tokens at their first request time; elapsed minutes refill at refillPerMinute up to capacity; each request consumes one token if available. Process requests in given order and return an accepted boolean per request. Time is nondecreasing for each seller.
assignments.design_prompt: Run a 15-minute design explanation, then 10 minutes STAR using a true experience; record what you would improve.

assignments.title: Timed mock: quote comparison feature
assignments.coding_prompt: Build a small comparison panel using the injected API: loading, partial results, selection, refresh, and error recovery. Keep the UI responsive while requests overlap.
assignments.design_prompt: 15-minute design explanation plus 10-minute truthful STAR story; note one tradeoff to revisit.

assignments.title: Retrospective: find weakest DSA topic
assignments.coding_prompt: From practice attempts grouped by topic, compute each topic’s total passed and total tests. Return every lowest pass-rate topic sorted by name; a topic with zero tests has rate 0. Include a tie case. Use the output to choose a truthful next-month goal in your notes.
assignments.design_prompt: Explain time/space tradeoffs for one prior design and list three follow-up gaps for the next month.

assignments.title: Practice retrospective panel
assignments.coding_prompt: Render attempted versus passed counts per topic, highlight all tied weakest topics, and capture one next-step note without claiming mastery.
assignments.design_prompt: Redo your weakest UI/API pattern, state accessibility/performance tradeoffs, and plan next 30 days.
